title: 第13章 娶妻生子第14章 突破会元境
slug: 八岁开始模拟的我觉醒重瞳
lines: 【同年，你的境界提升到了炼脏境后期，憾山拳提升到了融会贯通圆满之境，之后也与蜉蝣踏前斩一样进境极为缓慢。
得知叶家三祖正在炼制益骨生根宝丹，你的父母已经开始为你找寻条件与天资优异的姑娘。
【两月后，也许是因为家族获得了丰元小福地的原因，获取到一些之前难以获取的宝药，而也因此，三祖炼制了更多的玄级宝丹，炼丹手法越发的娴熟。
此次炼丹没有出现任何意外，成功炼制出了益骨生根宝丹，并且因为炼丹技艺的增加，时间提前了一月有余。
【很快就从父亲手中拿到了这颗玄级极品宝丹，有着服用经验的你，很快就把身体的状态调整到最佳，在准备好一切之后，你吞服了这颗益骨生根宝丹，并且此次你引导药力最大化，体内不久就排出少许的污秽，你对此毫无惊讶，因为服用宝丹之前，你的根骨就已经是黄级下品，并且因为此次引导药力的走向，你完美的吸收了这颗宝丹。
此次你的根骨提升到了黄级上品。
与你的预想相差无几，此时加上天生药心的天赋，即使是你父亲林昌明那种玄级上品的根骨，修炼速度想来与你也无甚差别。
如果搭配上丰元小福地核心内围的加成，已经能比肩那些没有洞天福地加成的地级根骨。
【在你根骨提升后，你的父母找到了你，正是此前与你商量的订婚的事情，此次他们给你找的女孩是叶家的客家弟子，女孩名叫李芙蓉，根骨资质达到了玄级中品，该女子在与你同代客家弟子中属于是最高者。
对于依附于叶家的客家子弟，能达到玄级中品的根骨，你也是小小的惊讶了一下。
要知道即使是如四大家族的嫡系，对于玄级根骨的弟子都不容易出现，出现的普通人身上，那与中大奖没什么区别。
【对于父母的建议，你并未直接答应下来，表示愿意与该女子接触，如果相处融洽的话会考虑一下此事。
对于你没有直接拒绝订婚的事情，叶昌明夫妻舒了一口气，他们很担心你是苦修士，最怕你不喜欢女人，那方面有问题。
得到你的回应，此前一直为此担心的夫妻俩，内心总算是落下了一块大石头。
毕竟你的父亲叶昌明本身就结婚过晚，能够生下你已经有点中奖的意味，而他后面的日子也基本不可能再有其他子嗣。
如果你不愿意孕育后代，那么他就可以判定是这一代绝后了。
【第三十七年，你与李芙蓉近两年的相处颇为融洽，对于李芙蓉的性格还算满意，李芙蓉的年龄比你大十三岁，因为修为达到了炼脏境初期的原因，样貌与十八岁无异。
之所以你们两人相处不错，原因便是因为李芙蓉虽然不及你对于修炼那么刻苦，但也是少见的愿意花费大量时间在修炼上的人。
平常对于其他人的接触不多，整个人也颇为单纯，更因为父亲早逝，从小与母亲相依为命，在被检测出根骨前，小时候受过一些苦，所以即使有着很好的根骨，为人也并不骄横。
你与李芙蓉相处，看起来反而你更成熟，像她的哥哥。
【而你也因为早早就突破到了练脏期，导致你的身材样貌都极为不错，加上数十年的绘画的熏陶，显得整个人都很阳光，儒雅。
在整个丰元城，如果真要排名的话，也许颜值不一定能上前十，但加上气质，你的魅力可称前三。
content_en:
[In the same year, your realm was promoted to the late stage of refining the internal organs, and the Shanshan Quan was promoted to the realm of integration and perfection. After that, your progress was extremely slow like the Mayfly Stepping forward.
Knowing that the third ancestor of the Ye family is refining the bone-boosting and root-boosting elixir, your parents have begun to look for a girl with excellent conditions and talents for you.
[Two months later, perhaps because the family obtained the Fengyuan Little Blessed Land, they obtained some precious medicines that were difficult to obtain before. Because of this, the Third Ancestor refined more Xuan-level treasure pills, and his alchemy techniques became more and more proficient.
There were no accidents in the alchemy this time, and the bone-boosting and root-boosting elixir was successfully refined, and due to the increase in alchemy skills, the time was advanced by more than a month.
[You quickly got this Xuan-level top-grade elixir from your father. With experience in taking it, you quickly adjusted your body's condition to the best. After preparing everything, you swallowed this bone-boosting and root-boosting elixir. This time, you guided the medicine to maximize its power, and a little filth was discharged from your body soon. You were not surprised by this, because before taking the elixir, your root bones were already yellow-level low-grade, and because of this guidance of the medicine's power, you absorbed the elixir perfectly.
This time your root bone has been upgraded to the top yellow level.
It's not much different from your expectation. At this time, coupled with the talent of innate medicine heart, even if your father Lin Changming has a high-grade Xuan-level bone, his cultivation speed is not much different from yours.
If coupled with the bonus from the inner core of Fengyuan Xiaofu Land, it can already rival those earth-level bones without the bonus from Dongtian Paradise.
[After your root bone was promoted, your parents found you. It was the engagement they had discussed with you before. The girl they found for you this time was a Hakka disciple of the Ye family. The girl's name was Li Furong. Her root bone qualifications reached the Xuan level middle grade. This woman was the highest among the Hakka disciples of your generation.
You are also a little surprised that the Hakka children who are attached to the Ye family can reach the mid-level Xuan level.
You must know that even direct descendants of the four major families are not easy to appear to Xuan-level disciples. If they appear to ordinary people, it is no different from winning a big prize.
[As for your parents' suggestion, you did not directly agree to it, but expressed your willingness to contact the woman. If you get along well with her, you will consider the matter.
Ye Changming and his wife breathed a sigh of relief that you didn't directly refuse the engagement. They were very worried that you were an ascetic monk. They were most afraid that you didn't like women and had problems in that area.
After receiving your response, the couple who had been worried about this before finally felt a big stone fall in their hearts.
After all, your father, Ye Changming, got married too late. Being able to give birth to you is already a bit of a lottery, and it is basically impossible for him to have other children in the future.
If you are unwilling to conceive offspring, then he can determine that this generation will be extinct.
[In the thirty-seventh year, you have gotten along quite harmoniously with Li Furong in the past two years. You are quite satisfied with Li Furong's character. Li Furong is thirteen years older than you. Because his cultivation has reached the early stage of Zang Refining Realm, his appearance is no different from that of eighteen years old.
The reason why you two get along well is because although Li Furong is not as diligent in cultivation as you are, she is also one of the rare people who is willing to spend a lot of time in cultivation.
He usually doesn't have much contact with other people, and he is quite simple. Moreover, because his father died young, he has been dependent on his mother since he was a child. Before his bones were detected, he suffered some hardships as a child, so even though he has good bones, he is not arrogant.
When you get along with Li Furong, you seem to be more mature, like her brother.
[And because you broke through to the visceral training stage early, your figure and appearance are extremely good. Coupled with the influence of decades of painting, you look very sunny and elegant.
In the entire Fengyuan City, if you really want to rank, your appearance may not necessarily be in the top ten, but combined with your temperament, your charm can be ranked in the top three.
title_en: Chapter 13 Marrying a Wife and Having Children Chapter 14 Breaking through the Huiyuan Realm
